maria: FYI — tenant tenant-acme-42 reports they suddenly lost access to model 'redwood-llama-2' in the console and the billing page returns 403. Customer says this started after yesterday's roles refactor. Escalating to sec/platform. @jake @leah :eyes:
jake: Ack. Can you paste the audit logs and the exact role names the tenant previously had?
maria: Pasting relevant lines from audit: ```
2026-03-19T22:01:12Z audit service=roles-svc actor=deploy-bot event=role_update role=ml.viewer -> ml.viewer_v2 action=replace
2026-03-19T22:03:10Z auth service=api actor=proxy event=auth_fail uid=acct-1234 resource=console.billing code=403 reason=missing_permission perm=tenant.billing.view
2026-03-19T22:04:02Z auth service=api actor=proxy event=auth_fail uid=acct-1234 resource=models/redwood-llama-2 code=403 reason=missing_permission perm=model.invoke
```
samir: Any KMS errors or encryption/key permissions?
maria: No KMS errors in logs — everything points at RBAC denies for both model.invoke and tenant.billing.view.
leah: Looks like the migration renamed ml.viewer -> ml.viewer_v2 but the tenant-specific bindings weren't migrated. Quick workaround: we can grant ml.viewer_v2 back to the principal while we fix the role-sync mapping. Example curl: ```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 'https://console.internal/api/v1/tenants/tenant-acme-42/role_bindings' 
 -d '{"principal":"acct-1234","role":"ml.viewer_v2"}'
```
jake: We prefer not to hand-edit if we can avoid it, but short-term emergency grant is fine with owner consent. Maria — do we have approval from the tenant owner to apply an emergency grant?
maria: Owner confirmed. Applying now.
devops-bot: grant applied principal=acct-1234 role=ml.viewer_v2 at=2026-03-20T00:01:20Z
maria: Customer confirms access restored to model and billing :tada: — they can see usage and invoke model again.
leah: I'll open a PR to update the role-sync mapping and add a regression test to prevent un-mapped renames. Also adding an alert on role rename events that create zero-match bindings.
jake: Good. Please add a short playbook section: (1) emergency grant command, (2) how to identify affected principals in audit logs, (3) rollback steps. Mark this resolved once postmortem + PR merged.
maria: Filing the support ticket now with audit snippets and customer confirmation. Will link PR/PM postmortem when ready. Closing this thread.
